_comment: A pnpm monorepo on main/develop with a shared working tree: a web app, an API and the packages they share. Shows the four features the simple example does not: `when` (path-scoped gates), `expectNonZero` (a command that exits non-zero by design), `guard.extraDeny` (a repo-specific denial), and `postEdit` (immediate feedback).

gates.title: Rule 1 — shared packages never import an app
gates.fix: Move the shared code into a package, or pass it in from the app; never import apps/ from packages/.

gates.title: The generated API client matches the contract
gates.fix: pnpm api:generate, then stage the generated client in the same commit.

gates.title: Search benchmark run
gates.fix: Exits non-zero BY DESIGN when a sample misses its soft budget. The verdict is `pnpm bench:compare` against the committed baseline.

extraDeny.reason: Packages are published by the release workflow only: a local publish skips provenance and the changelog.

postEdit.remind: The API contract changed — the generated client is now stale. Run `pnpm api:generate` and commit the result in the same commit.
